description: Geodata of Reservoir Expansion Near Shwebo City In Sagaing Region, Myanmar is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters in the centre of Sagaing State in the areas of Kawlin, Kanbalu,Taze and Kyunhla Townships of Myanmar as imaged by the Radarsat-2 satellite on 30 July 2015 and compared with Sentinel-1 satellite data on 18 July 2015 and Landsat-8 satellite acquired 29 April 2015. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2025-11-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
